result.summary: The home screen is mostly well-rendered, but one restaurant title in the 'Popular right now' list is visibly clipped mid-character: 'Tokumaru Ramen' renders as 'Tokumaru Rame' followed by a partial letter, despite plenty of horizontal space being available before the rating.

issues.description: The restaurant name on the first 'Popular right now' card is cut off mid-glyph: it reads 'Tokumaru Rameı' with the final 'n' sliced in half. There is no ellipsis, and there is ample empty space between the title and the '4.8 (500+)' rating, so the title container appears to have an incorrect fixed/too-narrow width with overflow hidden.
issues.suggestion: Remove the fixed width constraint on the title so it can flex to fill the available space up to the rating element. If truncation is ever needed, use proper ellipsis truncation (text-overflow: ellipsis / maxLines with ellipsize) instead of hard clipping.
